text:
jana: did a quick trace during the 11:30 traffic blip. Host ingress shows parse/tokenize ~52% and many small writev paths.

kevin: can you attach the trace?

jana: https://perf.internal/trace/2991003333 (redacted). Top lines: 
```
  52.0% ingress_worker  ingress::tokenize_and_sanitize
  19.5% ingress_worker  grpc::writev_small_batch
  10.1% ingress_worker  kvcache::lookup_remote
```

oscar: re-tokenize issue again? is gateway pretokenize inconsistent?

jana: gateway pretokenize is opportunistic and we still run sanitize in host. we should pass a header to short-circuit sanitize for internal framed flows. low risk for internal clients.

kevin: small writev storm is likely from our miniframe framing. Maybe we can coalesce at the ingress worker level: buffer outgoing fragments for up to 3ms unless client is real-time.

oscar: curious if kernel-selector changes last week contributed. any correlation?

jana: nodes that switched to the low-latency kernels show higher writev CPU. suspect those kernels prefer single-shot small writes over batched IO.

infra-bot: note: canary slots currently: 2,5 free.

kevin: plan: (1) add header gate to skip host sanitize for internal flows (jana). (2) implement ingress coalesce buffer with adaptive window (kevin). (3) short-lived in-memory prefix cache in worker (oscar). (4) add kernel-selector metric: host_writev_penalty and incorporate into scoring (kevin + oscar).

oscar: will prototype prefix cache with 256 entries to start. memory overhead small.

jana: i'll send PR for header gate. small tests show skip reduces host tokenize by ~30% in sandbox.

kevin: adaptive coalesce: will use rate detector: if writev_rate > 400/sec enable 5ms window for 10s. Revert when rate < 200/sec. Add feature flag.

infra-bot: reminder: include flamegraph snapshots in PR and perf-runner checks.

kevin: thanks all, aiming for canary in 48h if tests pass.

oscar: good. also let's add a warn log if we see repeated re-tokenize attempts from same tenantmaybe misconfigured client.

jana: added to TODO.

kevin: merging plan, will coordinate canary slot. :rocket:
